mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, r.shop_id, r.order_id, r.content, r.score, r.images, r.status, r.create_time, u.nick_name as author_name, u.icon as author_icon, s.name as shop_name
from review r left join user u on u.id = r.user_id left join shop s on s.id = r.shop_id
mapper.select:
select
where r.shop_id = #{shopId} and r.status = 1 order by r.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from review where shop_id = #{shopId} and status = 1
select count(*) from review where user_id = #{userId}
